```{r NA Check function}
na_summary <- function(data, only_na = FALSE) {
  
  na_count <- colSums(is.na(data))
  na_percent <- colMeans(is.na(data)) * 100
  
  result <- data.frame(
    variable = names(na_count),
    na_count = na_count,
    na_percent = round(na_percent, 2)
  )
  
  if (only_na) {
    result <- result[result$na_count > 0, ]
  }
  
  return(result)
}
```

#FEATURES FOR CANCER/HEART DISEASE MODELS
```{r echo=T}
vars <- c("_MICHD","CNCRDIFF", "CNCRAGE", "CNCRTYP2","_RFMAM22", "_MAM5023",
  "_HADCOLN", "_CLNSCP1", "_HADSIGM", "_SGMSCP1", "_SGMS101","_RFBLDS5", 
  "_STOLDN1", "_VIRCOL1", "_SBONTI1", "_CRCREC2","CVDSTRK3", "COPDCOGH", 
  "COPDFLEM", "COPDBRTH", "_LTASTH1", "_CASTHM1", "_ASTHMS1", "CIMEMLOS", 
  "CDHOUSE", "CDASSIST", "CDHELP", "CDSOCIAL", "CDDISCUS", "PDIABTS1", "PREDIAB2",
  "DIABETE4", "DIABTYPE", "INSULIN1", "CHCKDNY2", "_SMOKER3", "_RFSMOK3", 
  "_CURECI2", "_YRSSMOK", "_PACKDAY", "_PACKYRS", "_YRSQUIT", "_SMOKGRP", "_LCSREC",
  "DRNKANY6", "DROCDY4_", "_RFBING6", "_DRNKWK2", "_RFDRHV8", "COVIDPOS", 
  "COVIDSMP", "COVIDPRM", "_TOTINDA", "SLEPTIM1", "PRIMINSR", "CSRVINSR", 
  "CSRVDEIN", "_HLTHPLN", "_HCVU652", "MEDCOST1", "CHECKUP1")


df <- brfss_ca[, vars]
#Rename and Recode to 0/1
# _MICHD: 1 = yes, 2 = no 
# _TOTINDA: 1 = exercised, 2 = no exercise
df$mic_hd <- ifelse(df$`_MICHD` == 1, 1, 0)
df$exercise <- ifelse(df$`_TOTINDA` == 1, 1, 0)

```
#Heart Model
```{r echo=T}
heart_model <- glm(
  mic_hd ~ exercise + SLEPTIM1 + `_SMOKER3` + `_PACKYRS` + DRNKANY6 + 
    `_RFBING6` + `_RFDRHV8` + `_HLTHPLN` + MEDCOST1,
  data = df,
  family = binomial
)

summary(heart_model)
exp(coef(heart_model))

```
#Sleep
```{r echo=T}
dfsleep <- subset(brfss_ca, select = c(`_MICHD`, SLEPTIM1))

# check missing
colSums(is.na(dfsleep))

# remove NAs
dfsleep <- na.omit(dfsleep)

# recode heart disease
dfsleep$mic_hd <- ifelse(dfsleep$`_MICHD` == 1, 1, 0)

# correlation
cor(dfsleep$mic_hd, dfsleep$SLEPTIM1)

# logistic regression
sleep_model <- glm(mic_hd ~ SLEPTIM1, data=dfsleep, family=binomial)

summary(sleep_model)

# odds ratio
exp(coef(sleep_model))
```
#bin sleep
```{r echo=T}
dfsleep$sleep_bin <- cut(dfsleep$SLEPTIM1, breaks=c(0,5,8,24),
  labels=c("short","normal","long")
)
table <- table(dfsleep$mic_hd, dfsleep$sleep_bin)
prop.table(table,2)
chisq.test(table)
```
